This dataset contains **1,720 high-quality spoken dialogues** in **Tunisian Dialect (Darija)**, focused on railway services and customer support scenarios.

At **Kilma.ai**, we focus on production-ready AI data. We have processed the raw academic XML files through a rigorous cleaning pipeline:
* **Filtering:** Removed incomplete, empty, or low-quality turns, reducing the original count from 1825 to a curated **1,720 high-quality dialogues**.
* **Formatting:** Converted from complex XML to standard **JSONL (Chat Format)** compatible with OpenAI, Llama 3, and Mistral fine-tuning.
* **Role Mapping:** Standardized speaker roles to `user` (Client) and `assistant` (Staff/Agent).
* **Normalization:** Cleaned text from excessive whitespace and non-textual artifacts.

# Indian Railways train delays

Scheduled and actual arrival and departure times for Indian Railways passenger train runs, one row per stop of each run. Each config covers a date range and comes from one source; both share the same columns. Every Parquet file holds the runs that finished on the date in its name, so filter on `start_date` to select runs by the day they started.

## 2026-10-10_

Collected by us from NTES (National Train Enquiry System, run by CRIS) once each run has finished, and published the next day. A new file is added each day and published files never change. NTES fills in times for stations that did not report, so `arrival_reported` and `departure_reported` say whether each time was reported or estimated, and `run_quality` summarises them per run. Runs can be completed, cancelled, partially cancelled, diverted or incomplete (we gave up waiting for them to finish).
